acceptance.definition: Verified Clouds fog/refraction video subset with twelve controls and nine attached animation channels: native CPU/GPU, authoring helpers, private WASM gates, real Host persistence, browser raster, production preview and independent production VP9 decode, actual editor history and same-edited-project export with independent bytes/timing/pixel review. This does not complete the overall integration goal.
acceptance.scope: Recorded native Vulkan and private Chromium SwiftShader paths, attached effects and static effect layers, Host-authored attached channels, twelve actual UI parameter edits and the two specified VP9 export fixtures only. Installation, Electron, performance and all-codec/backend coverage remain outside this acceptance.
acceptance.history: Each record applies only to its frozen inputs and stated scope. Earlier handoff notExecuted fields describe their historical stage; later results are separate records, not rewrites. Static fixtures and native GPU success do not imply browser or video acceptance.

contract.clock: Signed rational frame flooring and exact binary-f64 speed modulo; deterministic bounded phase, no wall clock. Speed zero does not disable explicitly authored wind animation.
contract.alpha: Premultiplied refraction with transparent exterior and separate fog-over composition. Nonneutral exact zero alpha canonicalizes hidden RGB; explicit neutral identities preserve all source bytes after full validation.

cpu.scope: Catalog, strict admission, uniforms, independent seeded field vectors, signed frame/phase behavior and CPU WGSL validation; offline locked build with two jobs.
cpu.counting: The affected Naga test rerun is one repeated test, not an additional distinct case. The original 25 includes Droplets regression and shared catalog tests.
cpu.knownWarnings: Existing unrelated Liquid and editor-api MV dead-code warnings remain recorded.

gpu.scope: Neutral identity including hidden RGB; nonneutral coverage-zero canonicalization; fog-only alpha-over; independent affine-texture refraction and alpha edges; seed/wind/phase, repeated/reverse seeks and speed zero; malformed inactive raw uniforms.
gpu.limits: Native GPU tests are not browser hardware WebGPU or video encoder validation.

creatorAuthoring.scope: Image resource authoring, twelve static controls, nine attached channels, ordered keyframes and strict validation; isolated real agent-copy packaging.
creatorAuthoring.limits: Packaging uses main/renderer entry stubs, not an executable bundle or installed-plugin test. Existing no-unsafe-finally lint failure remains in stylized-package.test.cjs; this is not an all-green lint result.

hostPersistence.scope: All twelve controls and nine attached channels, inclusive bounds, distinct source/effect seeds, offline imported PNG and exact memory/revision/project-byte preservation after rejected multi-operation batches.
hostPersistence.limits: Six Host close/reopen cycles within one Bun process, not fresh OS-process restarts. No rendering or editor history was tested.

wasm.scope: Private release build with no dependency install, offline/locked/two jobs; exact ABI, remapped paths, Bun and Node initialization, real migration-chain loading and negative controls.

acceptanceTooling.scope: Independent optical/time reference, fixed quality gates and negative controls, immutable artifact capture, source-closure guards, pipeline fixtures and actual-editor/export fixture preparation. Focused typecheck, lint and format checks passed.
acceptanceTooling.counting: Repeated 14-test oracle runs are not additive; the earlier nine artifact tests are included in the later 27-test harness run. Fixture tests do not imply execution of the browser or export workflow.

browserRaster.scope: Clouds native resolver/raster at landscape and portrait sizes with legal opaque, holes and transparent canvas inputs. All twelve controls, signed frame/phase and neutral identities are covered.
browserRaster.counting: 215 result records consist of 212 pixel cases, one combined admission/phase record and two scope notes; scope notes are not additional tests.
browserRaster.limits: Canvas may canonicalize hidden RGB before upload/readback. Raw hidden-RGB behavior is established by the separate native Vulkan tests, not this browser run. Raw raster frames are not encoded video acceptance.

preview.scope: Real CanvasRenderer/WasmCompositor: attached and static effect-layer placements; opaque, holes and transparent sources; active boundaries, frame flooring, reverse/repeat seeks, offset/trim invariance, nine isolated attached channels and full alpha-frame replacement preserving caller composite mode.
preview.counting: 87 direct pixel records in the 103-record preview subsection; the separate alpha-replacement nested capture and six pre-encode reference captures are not added to that count.

video.decoder: Independent FFmpeg/FFprobe with default chroma reconstruction
video.reference: Independent Clouds optical/time reference on the fixed cut-out source, composited over black; not production capture pixels.
video.timing: All six frame and packet timestamps/durations pass; frame end, packet end and container duration are 0.2 seconds.
video.counterfactualScope: Independent decoder repeats expected frame zero; the browser fixture separately rejects repetition of decoded frame zero for frames one through five.

productionPipeline.limits: Fixture resource registry only; this run does not establish installed UI, editor-history or hardware-performance acceptance. This production pipeline export is distinct from the separately verified same-UI-edited-project export.

editor.transport: Actual Host staticDir and authenticated URL; attached editor task runner.
editor.keyframeScope: Host-authored channels rendered by the actual editor; three sample times, reverse seeks and reload. This does not claim UI keyframe creation.
editor.knownNoise: Two optional graph-editor user-presets HTTP 404 console entries, unavailable WebGPU adapters and a Canvas2D readback hint; 54 build warnings retained. No external requests.

sameProjectExport.source: Original run-P3egh3 UI-edited project, original recorded editor-dist path and original Clouds WASM; no parameter replay or project recreation.
sameProjectExport.independentDecoder: Fresh default FFmpeg/FFprobe invocation in a separate CPU review; no chroma reconstruction override.

geometry.policy: First complete integer canvas from the predeclared 1440-wide, 1000..1127-high viewport list.
geometry.normalization: Full 638x358 canvas scaled to 640x360 with bicubic filtering; seven independently regenerated raw RGB references match the saved normalized PNGs exactly.
geometry.reference: Complete neutral actual-editor canvas; same unfiltered imported-image baseline. Not an independent optical solver reference.

persistence.uiStageChanges: Before the export baseline, only metadata/summary updatedAt and timelineViewState.playheadTime changed; independent JSON comparison reproduced all three changes.

sameProjectExport.limits: Current editor-dist hashes are captured in the independent review, but no separate pre-export dist byte manifest was supplied; original dist reuse is supported by the matching recorded path. This CPU review did not rerun the browser or establish installed-plugin, Electron or performance behavior.
sameProjectExport.knownNoise: One optional graph-editor user-presets HTTP 404, unavailable WebGPU adapter and Canvas2D readback hint; no external requests or page errors.

retainedDiagnostics.reason: The npx-spawned Bun bare-import probe produced no result for over ten minutes with negligible CPU. The owned runner and descendants were stopped by the coordinator; the original log is retained. The exact cause is unproven. Later direct invocation of the same Bun binary and the remaining gates passed without changing the WASM.

verified: Native catalog, strict admission, deterministic field/clock, alpha rules and real Vulkan texture rendering within the recorded test scope.
Creator authoring helpers and isolated agent-copy packaging behavior, subject to the recorded lint and bundle limitations.
Private WASM build and source/path/API/initialization/control gates.
Real Host transaction atomicity, control/channel persistence and resource reopening.
CPU/static correctness of the prepared browser, pipeline and editor acceptance tooling.
Private WebGL browser raster and real production preview against the independent optical/time reference.
Six-frame production VP9 through browser and independent default-FFmpeg decoders, including fixed quality/timing gates and negative controls.
Actual editor editing of all twelve controls, attached-session undo/redo, rendering of nine Host-authored channels, reload and persisted project/resource reopening.
Same-UI-edited-project VP9 export, independently repeated default decoding and pixel/timing checks, source hashes and exact four-stage project-byte preservation.
notVerified: Installed Creator Studio/Rocut plugin, Electron runtime or browser hardware WebGPU.
UI creation of attached keyframes; effect-layer animation remains unsupported.
Alpha-preserving video, all-codec/all-backend coverage, performance and resource/latency bounds.
Whole-current-worktree build, shared dependency replacement, commit, push, release or overall-goal completion.

isolation.method: Task-owned artifacts and private source/package inputs; evidence records retain consumed hashes and scope.
